Episode 223. Uncomfortable Meetings (4)
Three days had passed since Kelliark went to the Prison No.3 of Dokmaseong.
And the Vamel Alliance received a letter from a pub in the Mila Kingdom. This pub is a top-tier membership bar called 'Curtain', one of Misha's hideouts.
"Oh... Amazing. He said he would set up a regular contact network somewhere in Inse, I didn't expect he would use this place."
The ones who sent the letter through Curtain were none other than Tilius and Misol.
"Huh? How did they find that bastard's hideout? They are clever. Kid, I have now fully recovered, so let's go together."
Jin and Murakan immediately headed to the Mila Kingdom on their Red Owl.
"Have you arrived?"
Following the manager's guide into the room, Tilius and Misol got up and welcomed the two as they entered. Tilius and Misol were enjoying the high-quality food of Curtain.
"Fortunately, it seems like everything has been fine since you returned. Tilius, Misol."
"That's what happened."
"The food in Inse is really delicious. Do you live eating this every day? Most of what we eat is the processed souls of those who fell into hell. Besides, is this the Black Dragon Murakan?"
"Why does this guy talk so fast. Yes, it's Murakan."
"It's nice to meet you, Murakan. I'm Misol. As you may know, this is Tilius. Let's greet officially."
"Most of the explanation will be done by Tilius this time as well...... Misol, please understand."
"Of course, Jin Runcandel."
Sitting down, Jin examined the two.
"How did you find this place?"

"We looked for the most difficult general facilities to access in Inse. Except for those in Kinzelo and Zipple, we mainly searched in Hufepes and neutral areas. And when we made a reservation under the name of Silkyia Arsia, only this place willingly accepted."
"Silkyia Arsia?"
"She is a member of the Jinma world who helped the Black Dragon Misha during the Kingdom's Guardian War. She is also a member of Biseopseu."
Although it was not well known, Jin had heard from Zephyrine that the demon army at the time of the Kingdom's Guardian War was a mixture of Jinma's demons and the demons of the Middle World.
"Eh? That evil creature helped the demons of Jinma during the Kingdom's Guardian War? I haven't heard such a story. Even though I don't like mixing words with that evil creature usually."
"You can find out directly from Black Dragon Misha."
As Misha is currently acting on behalf of Solderet, it was not a problem that could be confirmed right away.
Soon after, Jin called the manager, who confirmed that what Tilius said was true.

"The owner has notified all hideouts that operate externally, like our 'Curtain', about the name Silkyia Arsia. She is a person who has a debt to pay, so he has ordered us to accept her reservation at any time. There are several more people like that, most of them are dragons."

Once the manager retreated, Jin nodded. He was not a person who could be bribed, and even if Tilius and Misol had the ability to brainwash or manipulate minds, there was no reason to choose the Curtain. If they had such abilities, it would be better to choose someone from Tikan or Hufepster.
"An interesting connection. Did Misha help her knowing that she is a member of the Jinma world?"

"She probably just thought she was a demon. At that time, like many demons, Silkyia was forcibly conscripted and eventually deserted. While evading the pursuit team, she was injured and ran into a cave where she met Black Dragon Misha."
"That creature is not the type to help anyone, especially if they're demons."
"Well…… I don't know why Black Dragon Misha helped Silkyia at that time. Without Misha, Silkyia would surely have died. Perhaps Misha saw something in Silkyia."
"For example?"
"Something like a love for the world."
There was a moment of silence at Misol's answer.

"……We didn't hear this story from Silkyia until recently either. We heard it for the first time after we got in touch with you. After hearing the results of our contact with you, Silkyia suggested it. She told us to inquire at the top-tier pubs in Inse under her name. Thanks to her, we were able to establish a contact network so quickly."
The relationship between Misha and Silkyia was interesting, but it wasn't the important issue right now. The truth could be verified at any time when Misha came to Inse for a while.
"Alright, I accept and let's move on. Then, I would like to know why you contacted us this time."
"We got new information to share with you."
"What is it?"
"It's a story about your brothers."
Jin's eyes widened.
"……If you mean brothers?"
"The ones who died and fell into hell. Myu Runcandel, An Runcandel, Lan Runcandel, and Byugo Runcandel."
Since the existence of the Jinma world, or Hell, was revealed, Jin often thought of those who were certainly fallen there.

When he went to check the first transition crack opened in Rompf of the Meltador Zehu Kingdom, he thought of Kidard Hole, and when he visited the largest naval base in the Jinma world, he saw the souls of tortured humans and was lost in thought for a moment.
He felt his murdered villains and brothers might be somewhere there. And now Tilius was telling him that this was a reality.
"Were they all in hell?"
"Indeed. And Phaerlito is planning to use them to strike Luna Lundkundel."
Of course, Phaerlito had never told Tiliath and Misol about this plan. He had only issued an order to ban the production of soul drinks throughout the Demon World.
Biseups had speculated on this basis and recently obtained information that turned this speculation into certainty.
-"Then will it? Hmm, anyway! If the day comes to meet those twisted guys again, I'll have to scold them."
-"Would there be a chance to meet again?"
-"I will also die of old age someday, so wouldn't we meet in the afterlife?"
-"Even if the afterlife exists, you and them are probably in different places."
-"Is that so? Anyway, that's what I feel. I'll scold them. Whenever it is, if we meet."
The conversation Luna had with Jin when she returned to the Garden of Swords from the Black Sea.
At that time, Luna seemed to feel guilty for the brothers who were killed by attaching to Joshua and other evils.
She clenched her fist and said she would definitely scold them if they ever met, but Jin was worried about what would happen if such a thing happened.

"There is something called a soul drink. It's a liquor made by the demons by processing the souls of humans who have fallen into hell. Phaerlito has stopped the production of soul drinks to find them, and Misol and I went to Tokmaseong before fighting with White Whale. But the owner of Tokmaseong, Ragal, was drinking soul drink."

There were also Biseups spies in Tokmaseong. One of them was a jailer in the underground prison, who did not directly manage the first, second, and third prisons on the lowest floor, but was in a position to obtain some information about those prisons.
"If you're Ragal... The demon who made Elona Zipple injured? Dealing with poison."

"That's right. Ragal Pun, he is always looking for an opportunity to surpass Phaerlito. For some reason, he is also being favored by Zito. Anyway, the spy we planted in Tokmaseong said that Ragal has captured those who are presumed to be your brothers."
Ragal is a person who threatened even Elona Zipple using despicable means. It was stifling to think that such a Ragal had a card that could be Luna's weakness.
"So Ragal was drinking soul drink. Can you get them out?"
"It's impossible for now. The lowest floor of Tokmaseong prison is a special management area, so our spies cannot approach any further."
"What about informing Phaerlito that Ragal is holding them?"

"Although there is a clear difference in ability between the two, their positions are similar. Ragal is unlikely to be punished for things like disobedience. There is also a high possibility that Zito will wrap around...... Above all, whether your brothers are with Ragal or Phaerlito, the result is the same. It will be a psychological blow to White Whale."

The demons are still forming rifts without rest in many places in the guest room. It is difficult to exclude Luna, who is standing at the forefront and suppressing them, from the battlefield for the time being.
If so, it was a foregone conclusion that Luna would meet her brothers.
"Can you know when they will be deployed in battle?"
"I suppose we could estimate that. All our spies have to do is confirm the day when the lowest level of the prison in the Poison Castle opens."
Jin nodded, extending a communication device towards them.
"This is a communication device. Install it in the barrier, and request communication immediately when my brothers on the battlefield in hell appear."
"So you're planning to fight directly, keeping White Whale on standby only then."
"Yes. But Tillyas, if a soul that's already dead is cut once more...... what happens?"
"It vanishes. It ceases to exist anywhere in this world. It can't stay in hell, nor ascend the path of reincarnation."
Jin nodded heavily.
"Is there any more information you can provide?"

"There's a character named Leila Belgasium, the younger sister of Phaelito. She seems to be performing some separate command under Zito's order... but we haven't secured any details yet. However, Leila Belgasium will soon appear in the human world. She's on a different level than the other demon kings you've faced so far, so be careful."
"Got it."
"We'll contact you through here next time we meet. We've been granted a break for a while since the last battle, so we'll be able to communicate with you more freely."
At the same time, in the Poison Castle.
Kelliark was enjoying a feast with Ragal, thanks to his hospitality.

"You've already found five worthwhile souls from the Zipple side... It's a real fortune to have a friend like you, isn't it? That's why I took you out of the prison today. It's no fun to drink in such a gloomy place all the time, right?"
Kelliark responded with a smile rather than words. Just as the two were about to toast, a servant suddenly rushed into the banquet hall.
"Lord Ragal!"
"What is it?"
"There's a problem in the lower level of the prison...! They say all four prisoners have disappeared!"
"What!"
Ragal immediately rushed to the underground prison. The jailers were all unconscious, and cells 1, 2, and 3 were wide open and completely empty.
"Immediately seal off the entire poison zone and find them!"
Soon after, Ragal looked at Kelliark, who had followed him late, and gritted his teeth.
"Kelliark Zipple... I thought of you as a friend. How dare you stab me in the back like this? I, Ragal, will personally show you why hell is hell from now on...."
